objective: Adversarially evaluate and optimize the whole Codex development environment against repeated user feedback, with TypeScript/Bun as the new engineering runtime.
scope: MCP, official Chrome DevTools, Playwright fallback and Google Drive connector
academy site/app read contract and effect safety
Git dirty work, source locks and recovery boundaries
exclusions: No production LMS or academy Sheet write
No deployment, send, deletion or account/access change
No credential discovery, raw student dump or broad session transcript dump
No claim that a page shell or HTTP 200 proves student joins

phases.task: Derive a binary Pass/Fail rubric from repeated user feedback, root and nested instructions, current code/evidence and official runtime contracts. Cover false-pass traps, evidence grades, data minimization, repeat-question prevention, tool authenticity, recovery and regression gates.
phases.output: structured rubric with criterion ID, failure example, required evidence, test method, severity and exact source; no edits or raw dumps
phases.gate: Root reviews rubric for missing domains and ambiguous criteria before any evaluator starts.

agents.name: build_data_evaluator
ownership: source locks and Git dirty state

phases.task: Apply the same R1 rubric independently to assigned domains. Run only bounded, read-only checks and distinguish configured, connected, authenticated, source-only and effect-verified states.
phases.output: one evidence-backed scorecard per agent with exact reproduction and no file edits
phases.gate: Root deduplicates findings, resolves disagreements, checks false positives and forms a prioritized defect register.

phases.task: Fix only validated local findings. Preserve dirty work and assigned file ownership; coordinate before touching another agent's files. New implementation and artifacts use TypeScript/Bun. Existing Python reader remains a scoped exception until a verified replacement exists.
phases.output: small reviewable patches, before/after behavior and focused tests per optimizer
phases.gate: No operational material move/retirement without exact consumer and recovery review; no production effect.

phases.task: Review combined diffs against R1, rerun failed canaries and focused gates, check current-state/index and tool registration, and record every unresolved boundary.
phases.gate: Completion requires evidence for each rubric criterion or an explicit deferred reason; synthetic and local passes stay distinct from production acceptance.

sharedWorkspaceRules: Evaluators are read-only and can run in parallel after the rubric is approved by root.
Optimizers start only after the consolidated evaluation and own disjoint paths.
Root owns integration, shared documentation and final status.
No agent reads or prints the supplied session value, cookies, raw student records or media.
executionApproval: Approved by user after compaction on 2026-09-29; R1 researcher spawned. Model overrides in the draft plan are advisory only; agent spawns inherit the parent model unless a higher-priority instruction explicitly requests an override.
